name: kScReNI
method_summary: kScReNI is the transcriptome-only ScReNI variant for scRNA-seq data alone. It infers cell-specific regulatory networks by identifying neighboring cells with k-nearest neighbors and estimating random-forest importance scores as directed regulator-target weights.

threading.upstream_mapping: Wrapper maps ANDREA --threads to the kScReNI nthread execution pattern from Infer_kScReNI_scNetworks(): create parallel::makeCluster(threads), register doParallel, and run foreach over cells. The upstream per-cell GENIE3 call is fixed to nCores=1, so assigned threads control the outer cell-level worker pool rather than nested GENIE3 parallelism.

conditional_required.message: groups is required when execution.mode=group_aggregated because ANDREA aggregates kScReNI cell-native network rows by group.
conditional_required.usage: ANDREA uses groups.tsv after the native kScReNI per-cell run to aggregate cell:<cell_id> rows into group:<group_id> rows; kScReNI itself does not consume groups.tsv.

artifacts_aux.description: Combined stdout/stderr log from Seurat preprocessing, neighbor-graph construction, and per-cell GENIE3 runs.
Raw kScReNI-compatible R list of per-cell weight matrices before conversion to ANDREA network.csv.

progress.note: The kScReNI public entrypoint runs Seurat preprocessing followed by an internal foreach loop over cells and GENIE3 verbose output, but it does not expose a stable progress callback; the wrapper reports coarse lifecycle states in progress.json and records upstream diagnostics in kscreni.log.

nfeatures.description: Number of variable features passed to Seurat FindVariableFeatures(selection.method="vst", nfeatures=nfeatures) before PCA and neighbor graph construction.

knn.description: Number of nearest neighbors passed to Seurat FindNeighbors(k.param=knn); each per-cell GENIE3 run uses the cell plus the top knn neighbors from the SNN graph, and the wrapper requires knn + 1 to be no greater than the number of expression cells.
